situations.title: PONV 위험 선별
situations.tagline: Do you tend to get sick after anesthesia? I'm checking your risk for nausea after surgery.
situations.brief: 수술 전 환자의 PONV 위험 인자를 선별해 예방 계획을 세우세요.
keyPhrases: Have you felt nauseated after surgery before?
Do you get motion sickness easily?
We can add medication to prevent nausea.

situations.title: 오심 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I'm starting to feel a little queasy — is that normal after waking up?
situations.brief: 회복실에서 환자의 초기 오심을 사정하고 증상 정도를 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me how strong the nausea feels right now.
Some queasiness is common after anesthesia.
I can give you something to help settle it.

situations.title: 예방적 항구토제 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm she got her prophylactic antiemetics before we wake her up.
situations.brief: 수술 종료 전 예방적 항구토제 투여 여부를 확인해 PONV를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Did she receive her ondansetron already?
Let's confirm the prophylactic dose was given.
I'll note it before we emerge her.

situations.title: 체위 흡인 예방
situations.tagline: Let me turn your head to the side — if you feel sick, this keeps you from choking.
situations.brief: 회복실 환자의 체위를 조정해 오심·구토 시 흡인을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll turn your head to the side for safety.
If you need to vomit, let it come out, don't hold it.
I've got a basin right here for you.
goals: 구토 시 대처 방법을 환자에게 안내한다

situations.title: 구토 시 기도 보호
situations.tagline: Turn your head toward me — I'm going to suction so nothing goes down the wrong way.
situations.brief: 회복실 환자가 구토할 때 기도를 보호하고 흡인을 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: Lean toward me and let it all come up.
I'm suctioning to keep your airway clear.
You're safe — I've got you.

situations.title: 자극 최소 조절
situations.tagline: I'll dim the lights and keep it quiet — too much movement can make the nausea worse.
situations.brief: 회복실 환자의 오심을 줄이기 위해 환경 자극을 최소화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll keep the lights low and the noise down.
Try not to move too quickly for now.
Slow, easy breaths can help the nausea.

situations.title: 다중 위험인자 관리
situations.tagline: She's female, a non-smoker, with a history of PONV — she's high risk, let's layer our prophylaxis.
situations.brief: 여러 PONV 위험 인자를 가진 환자를 위해 다중 예방 전략을 계획하세요.
keyPhrases: Her risk factors add up to high PONV risk.
Let's use two different antiemetic classes.
We can also adjust the anesthetic to lower risk.

situations.title: 항구토제 병용
situations.tagline: The single agent isn't cutting it — let's add a second antiemetic from a different class.
situations.brief: 단일 항구토제로 부족한 오심에 다른 계열 약물을 병용해 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's add a second-line antiemetic now.
It should target a different receptor than the first.
I'll monitor how she responds after we give it.

situations.title: 멀미·PONV 병력 반영
situations.tagline: I always get carsick, and I threw up after my last surgery — please, I don't want that again.
situations.brief: 환자의 멀미와 PONV 병력을 반영해 강화된 예방을 계획하세요.
keyPhrases: Your history means we'll be extra proactive.
We can start prevention before you even feel sick.
A patch behind your ear can help with motion sickness.

situations.title: 마약성 진통 PONV 균형
situations.tagline: The pain meds are helping, but they're making me nauseous — is there a way to balance both?
situations.brief: 마약성 진통제로 인한 오심과 통증 조절 사이의 균형을 환자와 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We can add non-opioid pain relief to cut the nausea.
Let's find a dose that controls pain with less queasiness.
Tell me your pain level so we can adjust.

situations.title: 탈수·전해질 감시
situations.tagline: She's vomited a few times now — let's check her electrolytes and keep her hydrated.
situations.brief: 반복 구토 환자의 탈수와 전해질 이상을 감시하고 수액을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's draw electrolytes after repeated vomiting.
I'll keep her IV fluids running to rehydrate.
Watching her urine output and vitals closely.

situations.title: 지속 구토 재평가
situations.tagline: She's still vomiting despite two antiemetics — we need to reassess what else is going on.
situations.brief: 항구토제에도 지속되는 구토의 원인을 재평가하고 다음 조치를 계획하세요.
keyPhrases: You're still sick even after the medications.
Let's look for other causes beyond typical PONV.
I'm going to update the anesthesiologist on this.

situations.title: 소아 PONV 관리
situations.tagline: He keeps throwing up since he woke up — is there something safe you can give a child for that?
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 PONV를 관리하고 보호자에게 안전한 중재를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, we have antiemetics that are safe for children.
We'll dose it by his weight to keep it safe.
Small sips and rest will help too.

situations.title: 비약물 중재
situations.tagline: The medicine's on board — let me also try a cool cloth and some slow breathing with you.
situations.brief: 약물 외에 비약물 중재를 활용해 환자의 오심을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's try slow, deep breaths together.
A cool cloth on your forehead can help.
Pressing this point on your wrist may ease the nausea.

situations.title: PONV 퇴원 지연
situations.tagline: I know you were hoping to go home, but the nausea means we need to keep you a bit longer.
situations.brief: PONV로 인해 퇴원이 지연되는 상황을 환자에게 설명하고 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: Your nausea needs to settle before it's safe to leave.
We'll keep treating it and watch how you do.
This is to make sure you recover well at home.

situations.title: 구토물 흡인 발생
situations.tagline: She aspirated her vomit — turn her, suction now, and I need oxygen on her right away.
situations.brief: 회복실 환자가 구토물을 흡인한 위기에서 즉시 흡인과 산소화를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Turning her to the side and suctioning now.
Getting oxygen on her immediately.
I'm calling the anesthesiologist to the bedside.

situations.title: 심한 탈수 순환 저하
situations.tagline: She's vomited so much her pressure's dropping — let's bolus fluids and call anesthesia now.
situations.brief: 심한 구토로 인한 탈수와 순환 저하를 인지하고 수액 소생을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Her blood pressure is dropping from fluid loss.
Starting a rapid fluid bolus now.
Paging anesthesia to reassess her.

situations.title: 반복 구토 상처 열개 위험
situations.tagline: Every time you retch it strains your incision — let me support the site and get your nausea under control fast.
situations.brief: 반복 구토로 인한 수술 상처 열개 위험을 인지하고 상처 보호와 오심 조절을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Hold this pillow firmly against your incision.
I'm getting your nausea controlled quickly.
Let me check your dressing for any strain.
goals: 반복 구토로 인한 열개 위험을 인지한다

situations.title: 흡인성 폐렴 조기 징후
situations.tagline: Her oxygen's dipping and she's coughing after that vomit — I'm worried about early aspiration pneumonia.
situations.brief: 구토 후 흡인성 폐렴의 조기 징후를 인지하고 즉시 사정과 보고를 하세요.
keyPhrases: Her sats are dropping and she's coughing.
I'm listening for crackles and increasing oxygen.
Let's get a chest film and call the physician.

situations.title: 난치성 구토 위기
situations.tagline: Nothing we've tried is stopping it — I feel awful, I just can't stop throwing up.
situations.brief: 여러 약물에도 멈추지 않는 난치성 구토 환자를 재평가하고 상급 조치를 계획하세요.
keyPhrases: I know this feels relentless — we're not giving up.
I'm escalating this to the anesthesiologist now.
We'll try a different approach and keep you hydrated.
goals: 난치성 구토를 재평가하고 상급 조치를 계획한다

situations.title: 전해질 이상 부정맥
situations.tagline: Her potassium's low from all the vomiting and now her rhythm's irregular — let's get anesthesia and treat this.
situations.brief: 반복 구토로 인한 전해질 이상과 부정맥을 인지하고 즉시 대응을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Her low potassium is causing this irregular rhythm.
I'm putting her on the monitor and running a rhythm strip.
Let's replace electrolytes and call the physician.
